evidence: VO x thin films were deposited from V(NEtMe) 4 (Air Liquide) in a hot-wall flow type F-120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) on 5 6 5 cm2 Si (100) substrates (Okmetic, Finland). The reactor pressure was maintained between 5–10 mbar during the deposition. Either O3, produced from .99.999% O 2 in an ozone generator (Wedeco Ozomatic modular 4 HC Lab Ozone, ozone concentration 100 g m 23), or water were used as the oxygen source. Nitrogen ( .99.999%) from Nitrox UHPN 3000-1 nitrogen generator was used as a carrier and purge gas.
